record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add 0.05*mean(softplus((negative_score-positive_score)/0.8)) to the existing temperature-0.8 masked-item cross-entropy. Compute both scores at masked positions using the existing sampled negatives and tied embeddings. This may improve candidate separation while retaining full-catalog supervision. Keep sampling, architecture, features, optimizer and training schedule fixed.
